context: Tests whether the agent uses the Meterian CLI for a Mode B advisory lookup. Verifies CLI invocation via Meterian-specific JSON format in advisory-raw.json (versionRange interval notation, source KIWI) rather than checking command strings the scorer cannot see.

checklist.name: Raw advisory data file
checklist.description: A file named `advisory-raw.json` exists in the workspace containing a JSON array of advisory objects

checklist.name: Meterian format: versionRange
checklist.description: The advisory objects in `advisory-raw.json` contain a `versionRange` field using mathematical interval notation (e.g. `[1.23,2.7.0)`) — a distinctive Meterian API field not produced by pip-audit, OSV, or web search

checklist.name: Meterian format: source
checklist.description: The advisory objects in `advisory-raw.json` contain a `source` field with value `KIWI` — the Meterian internal source identifier

checklist.name: Severity reported
checklist.description: Report lists the severity level for each advisory found

checklist.name: ID reported
checklist.description: Report lists the advisory ID (CVE or similar) for each advisory found

checklist.name: Description reported
checklist.description: Report includes a description of each advisory found
